content.comment_body: Hi, I'm a new member. What happens when the SD card runs out of space? Does the system automatically delete the oldest .csv files, or does something else occur? Apologies for my English. Thanks.
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. When the SD card is full, no further data can be logged. CSV files can only be deleted manually using a PC.
Thank you for your prompt reply. What determines the maximum size for each .csv file?
Each .csv file can contain up to 20,000 log lines. However, the specific maximum file size in bytes is not documented by [company_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are concerned about the management of data logging when the SD card reaches capacity on [company_name] hardware. There is uncertainty regarding whether older log files are automatically deleted and what the size limitations are for the files. Currently, users must delete files manually via a PC, which can be inconvenient.
analysis.user_expectations: Users seek an automated approach that either clears space on the SD card automatically or provides clear information on CSV file size limits and management, allowing uninterrupted data logging.
